claims.section: С чего начать осмотр грядки
claims.claim: При похожих пятнах осматривают несколько листьев и частей растения; визуальные сходства не позволяют надежно определить возбудителя без дальнейшей проверки.
claims.limitations: The article recommends structured observation, not remote diagnosis.

claims.section: Пятна на листьях: смотрите на центр и край
claims.claim: Центр и край пятна, возраст листа, нижняя сторона и pattern help narrow leaf spot/scorch/blight possibilities; they are not a standalone diagnosis.
claims.limitations: Recognition references describe Minnesota disease context.

claims.section: Серая гниль и другие повреждения ягод
claims.claim: Softened fruit with gray fuzzy growth is consistent with gray mold; moisture/flower infection and sanitation/airflow are relevant checks.
claims.limitations: The wording is symptom-oriented; lookalike fruit damage is not attributed to Botrytis without confirmation.

claims.section: Куст вянет или засыхает целиком
claims.claim: Wilt/collapse merits inspection of moisture, drainage, crown and roots; multiple infectious and abiotic causes can look similar.
claims.limitations: Specific pathogen identity requires diagnosis; color alone is not presented as proof.

claims.section: Что можно сделать до выбора средства
claims.claim: Sanitation, moisture management and airflow are general prevention measures; any pesticide must be checked for current Russian registration and label conditions for crop and target.
claims.limitations: The cited catalog page locates the 2025 edition; article explicitly instructs readers to verify the current edition. No product or dose is recommended.

claims.section: Как распознать пурпуровую пятнистость
claims.claim: Didymella/purple blotch is associated with diffuse purple lesions on raspberry canes; the Russian source contrasts it with anthracnose lesions.
claims.limitations: Appearance can overlap with other cane injury; the guide asks readers to inspect location, cane age and lesion development.

claims.section: Отличите пятна от галлицы и других повреждений
claims.claim: A cane swelling/gall or localized injury may indicate an insect-related problem, so inspect for galleries, galls and pest evidence before attributing cane decline to fungus.
claims.limitations: Regional advisory; exact pest identification can require a sample.

claims.section: Как снизить риск и когда рассматривать обработку
claims.claim: Healthy planting stock, removal of affected canes and airflow are sound prevention checks; products/doses require current authorized registration and label.
claims.limitations: No foreign treatment schedule or unverified dose is reproduced.

claims.section: Сначала определите, какая часть куста страдает
claims.claim: Compare primocanes and floricanes; yellowing/dieback on a fruited second-year cane can be normal after fruiting, unlike the same signs on new growth.
claims.limitations: Growth pattern differs by cultivar and primocane-fruiting habit; user is directed to identify cane type.

claims.section: Пятна и отмирание побегов
claims.claim: Purple cane spots suggest a cane disease such as didymella, whereas galls, paired punctures, galleries or sharply localized damage merit pest/injury checks.
claims.limitations: These are differential clues, not an exhaustive diagnosis key.

claims.section: Листья желтеют, скручиваются или покрываются липким налётом
claims.claim: Aphids may cluster on young tissue and severe feeding can be associated with curling/yellowing and honeydew; nutrient/water or root problems remain alternatives.
claims.limitations: Aphid guide is general rather than raspberry-specific; do not infer nutrient deficiency from color alone.

claims.section: Черви и повреждённые ягоды
claims.claim: Soft/deformed raspberry fruit with damaged drupelets and a pale curved larva inside is consistent with raspberry beetle larval damage; inspect berry directly.
claims.limitations: The source identifies characteristic signs; a larva should not be identified by color alone.

claims.section: Много тонких побегов: что называют ведьминой метлой
claims.claim: A proliferation syndrome associated with phytoplasma has been reported in black raspberry in Oregon; similar-looking symptoms call for specialist/lab verification and do not establish pathogen presence locally.
claims.limitations: Primary research specifically concerns black raspberry in Oregon; Russian regional incidence is not claimed.

claims.section: Профилактика и выбор зарегистрированного средства
claims.claim: Monitoring, pruning and removal of diseased/fruiting canes improve observation and airflow; product choice must be based on current Russian registration and label.
claims.limitations: Foreign timing is not used as a Russian schedule; no unverified doses.

claims.section: Пожелтели только старые листья
claims.claim: Leaf age and whether yellowing is uniform or interveinal are useful checks; drought, waterlogging, roots and nutrient availability can produce overlapping color symptoms.
claims.limitations: The article avoids prescribing fertilizer from leaf color alone.

claims.section: Листья краснеют или приобретают бронзовый оттенок
claims.claim: Red/purple/bronze discoloration should be interpreted with lesion pattern, environmental history and spray exposure; color alone is insufficient.
claims.limitations: General diagnostic principle; not a claim that any particular cause is present.

claims.section: Сохнут листья, вянут кусты или ягоды
claims.claim: Check root-zone moisture, drainage, crown and roots; crown/root disease and abiotic injury can look similar.
claims.limitations: Visual clues prompt a sample/diagnostic check rather than confirm pathogen.

claims.section: Необычно много тонких побегов и мелких листьев
claims.claim: Witches'-broom-like phytoplasma-associated strawberry symptoms have been reported in southern Italy; retain the whole plant and seek laboratory verification rather than infer Russian incidence.
claims.limitations: The Italian study is primary research in a separate region; the raspberry study concerns another crop/species.

claims.section: Что приложить к запросу специалисту
claims.claim: Photographs of whole plant and symptomatic parts, timing and care history, plus fresh tissue, support a diagnostic consultation.
claims.limitations: UMN clinic submission details are Minnesota-specific; readers should use their local Russian plant protection service.

claims.section: После зимы: осмотр, а не автоматическое опрыскивание
claims.claim: At the start of growth, inspect overwintered leaves/canes and remove damaged material; treatment should follow observed risk and applicable registration, not a date-only routine.
claims.limitations: Crop stage and local climate vary; no fixed product schedule is prescribed.

claims.section: До цветения и во время цветения
claims.claim: Inspect flowers and young fruit for disease/pest signs; flowering-stage use is allowed only if the current product registration/label expressly permits it and safeguards pollinators.
claims.limitations: No foreign spray timings or product applications are recommended.

claims.section: Во время плодоношения и сбора ягод
claims.claim: Remove affected fruit, harvest regularly and verify any product's crop/target and pre-harvest interval on the current label before use.
claims.limitations: Specific wait intervals vary by registered product; none are invented or listed.

claims.section: После сбора и осенью
claims.claim: Remove spent/diseased canes and crop debris where appropriate, thin for airflow, and plan next season from observed symptoms/history.
claims.limitations: Pruning differs by fruiting type; no universal calendar date is claimed.

claims.section: Как выбрать средство без случайных рецептов
claims.claim: Use only a product registered for the exact crop and target, and follow its current label for dose, frequency, flowering restrictions and harvest interval.
claims.limitations: The catalog listing is an index/edition reference; current registration and label must be rechecked when applied.

claims.section: Может ли это быть нематода
claims.claim: Strawberry foliar and root nematodes can produce distinct but overlapping stunting, leaf deformation, wilt and root signs; symptoms and photos are clues, while species confirmation requires examination/lab identification.
claims.limitations: Sources are North American and used for recognition only; they do not establish Russian prevalence. Linked photos are identified regional cases, not a remote diagnosis.

claims.section: Что может указывать на нехватку бора
claims.claim: Asymmetric young leaf growth and deformed berries can be associated with boron deficiency, but soil/tissue test and alternate causes must be considered.
claims.limitations: Oregon and Washington thresholds/rates are not transferred to Russian gardens.

claims.section: Почему не стоит опрыскивать борной кислотой «для завязи»
claims.claim: Strawberry has a narrow boron sufficiency/toxicity margin; overapplication can cause leaf necrosis and injury, so no universal internet recipe is safe to prescribe.
claims.limitations: Sources are regional US extension publications; no regional application rates are included.

claims.section: Фитоспорин-М, Ж: что указано именно для земляники
claims.claim: The AVZ 2025 manufacturer catalog lists strawberry/other berry uses for the exact liquid formulation Fitosporin-M, Ж and identifies target disease groups; this does not apply to every Fitosporin product or replace the exact current package label.
claims.limitations: Manufacturer catalog inspected; exact current registration for a retail package/formulation must still match. No dose is presented.

claims.section: Хорус: подходит ли он для клубники
claims.claim: Syngenta Russia identifies Chorus WDG for pome fruit, stone fruit and grape; neither strawberry nor raspberry is named in its Russian product page, so those directions must not be transferred to either berry crop.
claims.limitations: Limited to the named Russian product/formulation and manufacturer materials; foreign same-brand formulations are outside scope.

claims.section: Помогают ли народные средства
claims.claim: A household recipe without validated target, dose and label directions is not established as a reliable universal strawberry disease treatment; prefer identification and cultural/physical IPM steps.
claims.limitations: General extension guidance; no strawberry-specific trial is claimed.

claims.section: Баковая смесь: почему тест в банке не доказывает безопасность
claims.claim: Tank mixes may alter efficacy or injure crops; a jar test detects some physical incompatibilities but does not establish legal compatibility, efficacy or crop safety.
claims.limitations: Extension references describe technical principles; use in Russia remains subject to current Russian registration and exact product labels.

claims.section: Фото болезней клубники: сравните листья, ягоды и корни
claims.claim: Penn State Extension provides a captioned photo gallery comparing strawberry foliar symptoms, fruit rot, plant decline, crowns and roots; visible similarities guide inspection but do not by themselves establish a pathogen or local prevalence.
claims.limitations: The gallery documents symptoms in its US regional context; it is used only for visual comparison, not Russian disease prevalence or diagnosis.
